    Normalized relative Hochschild cochains #

    For a length-graded algebra Λ with vertex idempotents e_i spanning S = Λ₀: normalized S-relative one- and two-cochains of internal degree q, the coboundary df(a,b) = af(b) - f(ab) + f(a)b (characteristic-two-construction.tex) and the cocycle equation dμ(a,b,c) = aμ(b,c) - μ(ab,c) + μ(a,bc) - μ(a,b)c = 0 (binary-families.tex). Classes in HH²(Λ)_q are cocycles of degree q modulo coboundaries of degree-q one-cochains.

    Also: a degree calculus for maps raising the length grading (Raises₁, Raises₂) used by the normalization arguments.

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.LenGrading.IsRel₁ {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} (V : G.Vertices) (f : Λ →ₗ[k] Λ) :
    Prop

    A normalized S-relative one-cochain.

    • left (i : Fin V.n) (a : Λ) : f (V.e i * a) = V.e i * f a
    • right (i : Fin V.n) (a : Λ) : f (a * V.e i) = f a * V.e i
    • unit (i : Fin V.n) : f (V.e i) = 0

      structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.LenGrading.IsRel₂ {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} (V : G.Vertices) (μ : Λ →ₗ[k] Λ →ₗ[k] Λ) :
      Prop

      A normalized S-relative two-cochain.

      • left (i : Fin V.n) (a b : Λ) : (μ (V.e i * a)) b = V.e i * (μ a) b
      • mid (i : Fin V.n) (a b : Λ) : (μ (a * V.e i)) b = (μ a) (V.e i * b)
      • right (i : Fin V.n) (a b : Λ) : (μ a) (b * V.e i) = (μ a) b * V.e i
      • unitL (i : Fin V.n) (b : Λ) : (μ (V.e i)) b = 0
      • unitR (i : Fin V.n) (a : Λ) : (μ a) (V.e i) = 0
